title: docs/derived/state/goal.json — the DURABLE goal contract
description: Written by kernel/lib/state.js writeGoalDoc() and mutated by kernel/lib/closeout.js. ⛔ THE SPLIT IS BY DURABILITY, NOT BY TOPIC: this file owns the contract (goal text, completion criteria, constraints, authority, forbidden) and is TRACKED, so a fresh clone still carries it; .respawnpack/runtime/contract.json owns which mode is active and is gitignored. An earlier cut had two independent goal representations with nothing reconciling them, which is the exact failure ADR-001 exists to end. additionalProperties is TRUE: this file is also a founder-editable surface (milestone, currentAtomicTask, ownerConfirmations, killedFeatures are read but never written by the pack).

completion.description: A free-text criterion is legitimate — some things only a human can judge — and evaluates to CANNOT_DETERMINE rather than being ruled on by the program in its own favour.

completionEvidence.description: Written only by completeGoal(), which REFUSES on an UNMET criterion (exit 1) and on an unevaluable one (exit 2) alike.

activeGoalId.description: ⛔ LEGACY, READ-ONLY. The pre-2d spelling. Readers accept it (state.js, closeout.js, respawnpack.js all try ongoingGoalId first); every writer deletes it. Declared so the tolerance is auditable rather than folklore.

goal.description: ⛔ LEGACY FLAT SHAPE, READ-ONLY. A pre-`goals` document is normalised into goals['G-legacy'] with legacyShape:true, so an existing project need not migrate before its state compiles.
